body.statement: For every \(\theta\in\mathcal N_\rho\), any random interval with coverage at least \(1-\alpha_0\) at both \(\theta\) and \(S\theta\) satisfies \(\mathbb E_\theta[\operatorname{length}(\mathcal C_n)]\ge(1-2\alpha_0)\lvert\gamma/\alpha\rvert\).
body.justification: Exact observational equivalence forces a nonvanishing honest interval at the no-breakout boundary.
body.gap: This honest-interval consequence is an incremental application of the standard two-point coverage argument; Kivva et al.'s population nonidentification result does not state the \(1-2\alpha_0\) expected-length factor.
body.consumer: The proposition prevents a narrow reported interval from masking exact source-label ambiguity when every flag vanishes.
